status: candidate; full hardware validation pending; PRs remain draft
scope: Userspace builds only; no installation, kernel patch edits, module reload or reboot.

offline.before: The initial four picture lifecycle cases fail against r10. Destroying the active target then ending the picture produces an ASan heap-use-after-free. A separate probe reproduces the prior completion code clearing a submission failure.
offline.limitation: The active-target sequence is deliberate API misuse with an intercepted codec; no malicious-video exploit has been established.

hardware_interrupted.reason: unrelated mpv process acquired the decoder
hardware_interrupted.source_note: Development build of the final implementation before changing the version marker from r10 to r11; no package hardware run completed yet.

resize_investigation.finding: Re-importing pixels cannot restore kernel reference-buffer dimensions/compression metadata or context probability state. The capture format setter rejects changes while buffers are allocated. A state-preserving kernel design needs separate work.
resize_investigation.loaded_module_limit: Source inspection does not prove the exact loaded module binary.
